title: IRRIGATION AND DRAINAGE
description: Familiarizes students with the principles and practices of irrigation and drainage systems. Optimum use of water, irrigation and drainage system design, installation, repairs, and troubleshooting are emphasized.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: CSS 305 or 205 or ((SOIL 205 or 205H) and (SOIL 206, 206H or FOR 206)).
A minimum grade of D- is required in CSS 305, CSS 205, SOIL 205, SOIL 205H, SOIL 206, SOIL 206H and FOR 206.
